kind: exploratory data and construct audit; no model calls
freeze_note: Written after initial source inspection found 11 linked INIs. Not preregistered and not confirmatory.

policies.interpretation: Use explicit Definite_Interpretation / Indefinite_Interpretation flags; preserve uncertainty
policies.INI_link: Keep all, enumerate for review; do not silently remove
policies.filler_spans: Retain the set of fenode IDs for a single FE as one source span; do not mislabel component nodes as alternatives
policies.coreference: No automatic equivalence expansion before separate coreference relation audit
policies.rendering: Original terminal words with token IDs; part nodes retained separately
policies.prior_diagnostic: Contiguous five-block development-only cross-validation; frame-role majority with global train-fold fallback, deterministic DNI tie break
policies.prior_interpretation: Within-one-document diagnostic, not independent document generalization
policies.inference: Descriptive counts only; no p-values or population confidence intervals

model_gate: Block original INI-as-no-specific-filler estimand when source evidence contradicts that mapping; keep research active and revise measurement. Counts alone do not establish gold validity.
